Title: Why Dark Circles Show Up Every Allergy Season (3 Everyday Culprits)

Description:
Dark circles flaring up right alongside the sneezing and congestion every spring or fall? It's not just sleep - allergies and a few everyday drinks and snacks could be part of the problem.

Coffee, alcohol, and salty snacks can each make the thin skin under your eyes look darker, whether through dehydration, dilated blood vessels, or fluid retention.

Watch to find out why, and simple swaps that help.
